courses.title: Point of Light Meditation
courses.description: A guided audio meditation drawn from Swami Rama's 61-point relaxation, moving awareness point by point through the chakras and marma points of the body. Laura Plumb offers it for deep relaxation and letting go of stress.

courses.title: Yoga Nidra
courses.description: A guided Yoga Nidra recording in which the listener stays aware while the body and mind settle into deep rest. Laura Plumb presents it from the yoga and Ayurveda traditions as a regular practice for relaxation and release of tension.

free_resources.title: Dosha Quiz
free_resources.description: A free online questionnaire on frame, sleep, digestion, temperament and mind that points to a person's mix of Vata, Pitta and Kapha. The results lead to a page of Ayurvedic suggestions for that type.

free_resources.title: Sumptuous Sleep
free_resources.description: Laura Plumb's free page on rest from an Ayurvedic view: sleep and ojas, the hours that suit each dosha, and an evening ritual. It links a candle-gazing practice, a guided meditation and alternate-nostril breathing.

left_out: Class 'Ayurveda Jyotish - Intro to Medical Astrology' (lauraplumb.com/product/ayurveda-jyotish-intro-to-medical-astrology/): the page presents reading a birth chart for potential health issues and prescribing remedies including herbal treatments and gemstone therapy; reads as diagnosing and treating, so still out under the new rule.
Ayurveda Integrative Nutrition training: the listing now has 10 offerings (the limit); the graduates' retreat page is a past event.
flags: Sumptuous Sleep mentions that ojas 'promotes strong immunity' in passing; kept, as it makes no claim that the page's practices treat a condition.
Dosha Quiz asks about symptoms such as high blood pressure and joint pain to find a dosha; kept (naming, no claim).
